name: ds-bridge
description: Connect your design system's Figma library to your codebase: token drift detection, DS-aware linting, design-to-code, and pre-handoff QA.

figma_file_key.title: Figma library file key
figma_file_key.description: Key from the library file URL

figma_token.title: Figma personal access token
figma_token.description: Dev/Full-seat PAT; scopes: file_content:read, library_content:read, file_versions:read, file_comments:read+write

token_source.title: Design token source file
token_source.description: W3C/Tokens Studio/Style Dictionary entry file. Auto-detected if unset

readiness_threshold.title: Handoff readiness gate
readiness_threshold.description: Minimum readiness score (0-100) for /ds-bridge:handoff-qa to pass a frame
